LE BARON II 6060 Rue Jean Talon Est, St Leonard, Quebec H1S 3A9 Téléphone: 514-256-5000 / (514) 281-1551 Courriel: 3234@gestionsib.com Situé à St-Léonard près de toutes les commodités et à 2 minutes de l'autoroute Métropolitain. Cet immeuble en béton vous offre la sécurité, la tranquillité, une très bonne insonorisation et l'air climatisé central. Chute à déchets sur les étages, salle de lavage dans les appartements, réservoir eau chaude 40 ou 60 gallons, comptoir en granite dans la cuisine. Plancher en parqueterie et céramique. Vue magnifique, balcon double, 2 ascenseurs, 2 escaliers de service, système de caméra et intercom. Beaucoup d'espaces de rangements dont une très grande garde-robe (walk-in) dans la chambre principale. Service de conciergerie 24h / 7 jours. Vous pourrez vous prélasser à la piscine, au sauna ou simplement en profitant des appareils d'exercices. Une visite s'impose pour apprécier la grandeur des appartements uniques et la qualité de la construction. Autobus 141 Jean Talon (métro Honoré Beaugrand Jean Talon Saint Michel). À noter que vous devez remplir les exigences suite à une enquête de solvabilité. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ( English) Apartment/condo for rent in st-leonard- VERY LARGE SURFACE AREA 4 1/2 starting at 1880$ per month (from 1250+ sq ft) 5 1/2 starting at 2625$ per month (from 1750+ sq ft) Penthouse available on demand (from 2200+ sq ft) Located in St-Léonard near all facilities and 2 minutes from Métropolitain Highway. This concrete building offers security, quietness, very good soundproofing and central air conditioning. Garbage chute on all floors, laundry room in the apartments, hot water tank of 40 or 60 gallons and granite kitchen counter. Ceramic and parquetry floors. Beautiful view, double balcony, 2 elevators, 2 service stairs, camera system and intercom. Lots of storage space including a very big walk-in closet in the master bedroom. Janitorial services 24 hours/7 days. You could enjoy the pool, the sauna or stretch out with the fitness equipment. NO PETS - PAS D'ANIMAUX 6060 Rue Jean Talon Est, St Leonard, Quebec H1S 3A9 Tel: 514-256-5000 / (514) 281-1551 email: 3234@gestionsib.com About Saint-Leonard East Explore the area Saint-Leonard East offers a slower-paced ambience and will appeal to those who enjoy spending time outdoors. This part of Montréal is very quiet, as there isn't a lot of street noise or city clamour. Lastly, greenery is quite present in this area; parks, including Parc Wilfrid-Bastien and Parc Ladauversière, are very well-situated and there are about 10 of them close by for residents to check out, which results in them being easy to reach from numerous locations within Saint-Leonard East. In addition, residents will find that the majority of streets have reasonably good tree coverage. This information is provided by a third party data source.
